# How a small ceramics studio stopped retyping orders

A small studio stopped retyping email orders [E-01]. Purchase orders now reach its order sheet the day they arrive.

## The problem

Every purchase order arrived as an email, and someone retyped each line into the order sheet.

## What changed

Email orders now land in the order sheet without retyping [E-01]. One paid directory lists support plans for this kind of flow at 300 to 600 a month [E-02].

## What we would do again

We recommend starting with the orders that already arrive as files.
